entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyway, let's try heading over to that[n]city we saw before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's pretty far away... This is my time[n]to shine!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't think I've ever been happier[n]you can transform into a car...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heheh. Leave it to me, Lady Ann.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what do you want to do? Should we[n]head over?
To the city we go.
Maybe later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Got it! Just give me a second to get ready!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh? Do you have something else[n]you need to do here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, just come talk to me at the [clr 2]return[n]point[clr 27] when you want to head into the[n]city.

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: What a surprise...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that Futaba!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba's Voice
entries.en: To think you would actually obtain[n]the key...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I suggest you don't underestimate us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, we can get over that wall now,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba's Voice
entries.en: That will still not be enough.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'mean there's more!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba's Voice
entries.en: That key thirsts. It wants.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: More cryptic clues?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What could an object want!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba's Voice
entries.en: That is your task to figure out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Think back to what Futaba just said...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What could she have meant when[n]she said the key "thirsts" and "wants"?
Just what it sounds like.
I thirst too...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait... Do you mean we should literally[n]put it in water?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I mean, it wouldn't be difficult to try.[n]There's an oasis right there...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In that case, you should head over to[n]that oasis and...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait. Could it be that we need to put[n]this key into the water?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope we don't get cursed for messing[n]with stuff we took from the pyramid...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It must be okay. Futaba's the one who[n]told us to do it, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come, let's head for the oasis.
